title: UltiSelf Review – A Major Disappointment and Warning
body:
UltiSelf is one of those apps that seems promising at first glance, but quickly turns into a frustrating and deceptive experience. The app aggressively pushes users to enter their credit card information with the promise of a trial period — but without any proper notification, it charges your account. Even worse, the subscription doesn’t appear under your Apple subscriptions, making it extremely difficult to locate or cancel.

The lack of transparency is alarming, and the entire approach feels unethical. The content and features of the app are also underwhelming — there is little to no value compared to many free habit-tracking alternatives available.

I do not recommend this app. It feels like a money trap disguised as a productivity tool. If you’re serious about self-improvement, look elsewhere.

⭐ 1/5 – I’d give zero stars if I could.

title: Disappointment and a Waste of Money
body:
This app is absolutely not motivating. The content is useless, offering nothing new or inspiring. The additional subscription for $80 is just silent videos with no meaning or real value.

Another major issue is the subscription system: you can’t simply cancel it in the settings—you have to contact support and waste time resolving it.

The app is severely overpriced. I opened it only twice—once after installing it and the second time when I tried to cancel the subscription. It’s absolutely not worth the money. I do not recommend it!

title: Нечестные методы списания: Ultiself пытается снять деньги без явного согласия
body:
Скачал приложение Ultiself, думая, что оно бесплатное, так как при установке не было указано информации о стоимости подписки. Однако позже обнаружил, что разработчики пытались списать деньги с моей карты без моего явного согласия. Банк, к счастью, отклонил транзакцию.

Такой подход вызывает серьезные вопросы к честности разработчиков. Пользователи должны четко понимать условия использования приложения, включая стоимость, еще до его установки.

Отказался от использования приложения, запросил отмену подписки и удаление аккаунта. Ожидаю реакции, но пока впечатления крайне негативные.

title: They stole my money
body:
I installed this app in around December 2023 thinking it looks good and could help me build up some better routine. But after paying 10 dollars for short term acces I realised the offer is pretty bad for the huge sums of money so I unsubscribed from any products offered and deleted the app. Couple days ago I got charged by this company whole $49 dollars as mobile service recharge???? I do pay my mobile phone in my own country’s currency and not in dollars and not to a company called Ultiself. So this was very sneaky way of attempting to charge me and hoping I would not notice. I did contact their support about it and received no info. Bear in mind — I did not receive any receipt from them nor did I get any product inside of their app after I downloaded this waste of disk space again. I am overly disapointed and by the pettiness of this company to attempt such theft. And I want to warn everyone not to give them any card info or even download this.

Edit (response to the developer response): I did contact your support and received zero response. I checked the lists of owned subscriptions or purchased products in the apple support multiple time during the last week. There is no product received. 

By also checking your trust pilot reviews this is not the first time these “accidental” charges happened.
